name: tangsancai
description: This project implements a web application that: 1. Uploads a video of a user performing actions. 2. Uses MediaPipe Pose Landmarker to extract 3D body pose landmarks. 3. Sends key frames to Gemini (Gemma-4-Vision-7B equivalent) to recognize the action/expression and match a 3D Tang Sancai avatar. 4. Loads a rigged 3D avatar (GLTF/GLB) in Three.js. 5. Retargets the MediaPipe 3D landmarks to drive the avatar's skeleton in real-time. 6. Records the blended dance (human + avatar or avatar only) using Canvas Capture and MediaRecorder. 7. Exports a high-quality MP4/WebM video.
